metadata.title: [FIX][UI]: Fix sidebar visibility on viewport resize (#2947)
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANA.R <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
closes #2947 
Previously, Alpine did not re-evaluate the sidebar visibility expression on viewport resize after mobile collapse.
Now, when width reaches lg and above, sidebarOpen is set to true, so the sidebar becomes visible without page reload

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, minimal fix that correctly addresses the bug.

**What was reviewed:**
- The `@resize.window` Alpine.js handler correctly triggers `sidebarOpen = true` when the viewport crosses the Tailwind `lg` breakpoint (1024px), restoring sidebar visibility after mobile collapse without requiring a page reload.
- The 1024px threshold is consistent with all `lg:` utility classes used throughout the template (`lg:hidden`, `lg:translate-x-0`, `lg:block`).
- No performance concerns — the handler is trivial and Alpine skips re-render when `sidebarOpen` is already `true`.
- No security implications — purely client-side UI state change.

**Test coverage added:**
- Added a Playwright E2E test (`test_sidebar_visible_after_mobile_collapse_and_resize`) that reproduces the exact bug scenario: desktop → mobile collapse → resize back to desktop → sidebar must be visible.

commits.message:
test(ui): add Playwright test for sidebar resize visibility (#2947)

Verify the sidebar reappears when viewport is resized from mobile
back to desktop after being collapsed, without requiring a page reload.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
